summary: Iteration 14 (both) — 'Historia zmian' (audit log) feature ALL GREEN. BACKEND: 22/22 pytest pass in 7.08s for /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14_history.py covering all requested review items — (1) event create/update/delete each append a matching entry with correct action/entity_type/entity_id/user_name/summary/at; (2) staff create/update/delete → 3 entries with entity_type='staff' and Polish summaries ('Dodano/Edytowano/Usunięto pracownika: <name>'); (3) expense create/update/delete → 3 entries with entity_type='expense' ('Dodano/Edytowano/Usunięto koszt: <label> (<amount> zł)'); (4) workspace ISOLATION verified — unrelated fresh user C sees GET /api/history == []; (5) workspace SHARING verified — user B joining A's workspace via POST /api/workspace/join with A's user id sees the exact same set of history ids as A, and a staff created by B is visible in A's history (top entry action='create', summary contains B's action); after workspace/leave user B's history returns to []; (6) DELETE /api/history clears only current workspace (A cleared → 0 entries, C untouched); (7) sort desc by 'at' confirmed; (8) ?limit=2 respected; (9) Regression: /api/events, /api/staff, /api/expenses GET/POST/PUT/DELETE all still 200 with log_change added. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport, test@eventa.pl/test123): 'Pracownicy' screen renders header buttons workspace-btn + history-btn (clock icon) + delete-account-btn + logout-button. Tapping history-btn opens the bottom-sheet modal 'Historia zmian (N)'. All 5 filter chips exist (history-filter-all|event|staff|expense|delete). Seeded 4 real audit entries via backend (1 staff create + 1 event create + 1 event delete + 1 expense create) and verified UI counts: all=4, event=2, staff=1, expense=1, delete=1 — correct. Each entry renders with the coloured icon circle (plus/green, edit-3/gold, trash-2/red), summary line in Polish ('Dodano koszt: TEST_UIhist expense (100.0 zł)', 'Usunięto imprezę: TEST_UIhist Event (2026-08-15)') and meta line 'Test  ·  12.08.2026, 00:54:10' (user_name + pl-PL timestamp). history-clear-btn opens a confirm (window.confirm on web) and after Accept the title updates to 'Historia zmian (0)' and 'Brak zapisanych zmian' empty state renders. No red screen, no console errors. Bundle console emits only the same pre-existing 'shadow* deprecated' + 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warnings noted in iter13 — non-blocking. Pre-existing 3 failures (test_iteration7 x2, test_iteration9 x1) are stale hardcoded event-count assertions against the shared seed account (assert count==3 but got 4) — UNRELATED to this feature; iter14 additions never touched /api/stats or the seed events. All test data prefixed TEST_ was cleaned up (staff deleted, history cleared).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:126-141 — log_change is defensive (try/except swallowed) so any Mongo hiccup does not fail the parent CRUD call. Good.
server.py:256-262 — GET /api/history uses ws(user) scoping (workspace_id, falling back to user id), sorts by 'at' desc, clamps limit to 1..500. Confirmed correct.
server.py:264-268 — DELETE /api/history scoped by owner_id=ws(user), does NOT touch other workspaces. Verified in test_delete_history_only_current_workspace.

server.py events/staff/expenses — log_change is invoked AFTER the DB mutation and uses the freshly-read doc for summaries (correct name/date/amount in summary text). Delete handlers only log if doc existed (avoids logging phantom deletes).
pracownicy.tsx:27-30 — 4 new state vars (historyOpen/history/historyLoading/historyFilter) declared; iter13 orphan-reference bug is confirmed fixed.
pracownicy.tsx:40-51 — openHistory awaits api.history(200), sets loading + shows Alert on error. Good UX.

pracownicy.tsx:178-260 — modal uses Modal transparent + backdrop pressable to close; filter chips inside horizontal ScrollView; entries mapped with typed action → icon+color triples; empty state 'Brak zapisanych zmian' handled.
pracownicy.tsx:244-251 — clear button uses window.confirm on web (Platform.OS === 'web') and Alert.alert on native. Correct dual-platform handling.
src/api.ts — api.history(limit) and api.clearHistory() implementations trusted (backend integration verified end-to-end).
